description: Match&Locate run parameters. Values not given take the defaults below; --config or <input-dir>/config.json supplies overrides. The defaults are generic starting points (upstream example window and thresholds, a 1 km local grid), not scientific policy for a case.

half_width_km.meaning: horizontal grid half-width about the template (square, both axes)

step_km.meaning: horizontal node spacing; half-width is rounded to whole steps

half_depth_km.meaning: depth half-width about the template depth; 0 fixes depth

step_depth_km.meaning: depth node spacing; must be > 0 even when half_depth_km = 0

deg.meaning: native -R/-I values; all steps > 0. half widths of 0/0/0 is the matched-filter case.

search.node_count: per axis int(2*half/step + 1); jobs.csv records grid_nodes. Shift-and-stack cost is proportional to nodes x samples x rows.

before_s.meaning: window start before the phase mark

after_s.meaning: window end after the phase mark; length_s <= before_s + after_s is enforced

cc_threshold.meaning: per-template: mean stacked CC >= this (-H first value)

mad_threshold.meaning: per-template: (CC - median)/MAD >= this, statistics per grid node over the whole segment (-H second value)

min_separation_s.meaning: per-template: keep the highest-N(*MAD) candidate within this many seconds (-D)

engine.meaning: python = port of SelectFinal on absolute times across all segments, without its 100,000-row limit; native = SelectFinal binary per segment

min_separation_s.meaning: across templates: keep the highest-N(*MAD) detection within this window; a CC = 1.0 self-detection is always kept

min_channels.meaning: skip (segment, template) jobs with fewer usable channel-phase rows; upstream warns below 9 (3 three-component stations)

output_mode.meaning: native -O: 1 stacked correlogram of each detection, 2 every node's full stack (very large), 3 CCdistribution.out of every above-threshold node and sample; files stay in jobs/<segment>/<template>/
